pages.text: Crystallized Bonds are a unique resource that can be found on $(l:structures/family_tree)$(c)$(o)Family Trees$() and used for the manufacturing of $(l:blocks/glasses)$(c)$(o)special glass$() or to create sharp edges for weapons. These are renewable and formed on $(l:blocks/bondknot)$(c)$(o)Popping Bondknot Wood$(), which cannot be removed without losing their ability to generate Crystallized Bonds.
